children.name: page-platform-subtitle
children.content: Turn Great Ideas into Awesome Products

children.name: page-platform-p-0
children.content: Create Awesome Products The Platform The Path to Production How it Works Turn Great Ideas into Awesome Products The Carbon platform allows for product differentiation and the opportunity to increase performance, introduce customization, and get to market faster than with traditional methods of manufacturing. Carbon unites groundbreaking technology with world-class expertise – helping companies transform new ideas into reality.

children.name: page-platform-p-1
children.content: Carbon’s industrial hardware, innovative software, and engineering-grade materials are designed to work together to help our customers design and produce breakthrough products on our platform. Our engineers work on interdepartmental teams, creating feedback loops that continuously advance our technology for the benefit of our customers.

children.name: page-platform-p-2
children.content: What’s more, when you work with Carbon’s technology, you also benefit from access to an ecosystem of specialists who work to help you create the best possible 3D design for the reliable production of a quality product.

children.name: page-platform-p-3
children.content: During discovery, Carbon can assess and optimize your design files for printability or connect you with one of our production partners to get started right away. We can support your product development cycle by working on design iterations and prototypes for validation.

children.name: page-platform-p-4
children.content: In the production phase, we align on goals including cost and timeline. From there, you can get into production with a member of our CPN network, which includes experts in ramping applications to production with the Carbon platform, or we can help you validate your own printer for production.
